decisions.reason: The source constrains copper-pour continuity and stitching vias downstream of the USB-C or battery connector; it does not change the USB-C connector's type, data-line support, or sourceability requirements.
The high-current routing conditions do not add, remove, replace, or otherwise change any connector in the integrated-board connector inventory.
The VBUS and BAT- copper-routing constraints do not affect the panel controls, their GPIO mappings, or their connector-based wiring.
The source addresses VBUS and BAT- routing between the power connectors and AXP2101, not the INA3221 monitoring of the downstream 3.3V and 5V rails; the monitoring topology remains valid unchanged.
